title: Impact of variations in ALD procedure on nanomorphology, protecting properties and chemical stability of thin TiO2 films
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,8658-8666
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09703G, Paper
Open Access

Hana Krýsová, Tomáš Imrich, Hana Tarábková, Pavel Janda, Josef Krýsa
Thin TiO2 films were deposited by atomic layer deposition (ALD) at 150 and 250 °C on FTO and Si/SiO2 substrates to examine the effect of deposition conditions on morphology, structure, chemical stability, and photoelectrochemical performance.
